findings.issue: Zero-added duplicate commit returns true without saving. Unconditional m_savedConfiguration update could mark unrelated unsaved edits as saved.
findings.disposition: Fixed by root; verified MainWindow now updates saved fingerprint only when report.addedCount > 0.

positive_checks: Fresh preview validates every source row against current catalog and current AppState.
Persistence uses a candidate AppState; tasks are published only after QSaveFile commit succeeds.
Existing on-disk configuration is copied to a non-overwriting backup before new persistence.
Lock acquisition failure does not alter tasks or backup.
Successful commit preserves existing tasks, follows, observed values and run settings.
Import dialog is modal and revalidates source bytes before issuing commitRequested.
